title: Day 683 — Sheinbaum Inaugurates New ISSSTE General Hospital in Tampico, 250 Beds
detail: On August 15, 2026 (Day 683, Saturday), President Sheinbaum and Tamaulipas Governor Américo Villarreal Anaya inaugurated the new Hospital General del ISSSTE in Tampico during the second day of her weekend work tour through Tamaulipas. The facility replaces the aging former hospital and will open in phases: phase one adds outpatient care across 35 medical specialties (up from 20) in 37 consultation rooms, plus pharmacy and physical-medicine services; the completed hospital will reach 250 total beds (150 censable, up from 103) and add MRI and hemodialysis capacity the old facility lacked. Officials cited a 2.3-billion-peso investment serving roughly 564,457 ISSSTE beneficiaries in the region.
